statement: A domestic corporation generally must file Form 1120 by the 15th day of the 4th month after the end of its tax year (April 15 for calendar-year filers); a corporation with a fiscal tax year ending June 30 must file by the 15th day of the 3rd month; when the due date falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday it moves to the next business day, and extensions are requested on Form 7004.
caveat: Short-period, dissolution, and June 30 fiscal-year rules differ, and an extension of time to file is not an extension of time to pay. Determine the applicable year's instructions and legal holidays from the live IRS publication; this repo does not calculate or extend the deadline.
